changes.text: ESX: Fixed characters sometimes not being saved after spawning, including when an external spawn selector is used.
Fixed a game crash when a scene or partner used a non-ped model.
Fixed the character preview sometimes failing to appear or spawning the wrong ped when switching characters quickly.
ESX: Loadout and death state are now restored correctly after selecting a character.
rcore_clothing skin reload now only runs on ESX.
ESX: A console warning is now shown if Config.Multichar is disabled in es_extended.
The version check now lists what changed in each version you are missing.
ESX: Character data is now saved correctly on relog and reconnect.
ESX: Fixed issues with the logout command.
ESX: Fixed an issue with deleting characters.
